settings.question: How long until I notice a difference?
settings.answer: Hair grows on roughly a 90-day cycle. Many people notice reduced shedding earlier, but we encourage a full 90 days of consistent use. Individual results vary.

settings.question: How do I take Kesha Mula?
settings.answer: Take one serving every morning. Mix with water, buttermilk or juice. Drink on an empty stomach for best absorption.

settings.question: Can men and women both use it?
settings.answer: Yes. Formulated for adults experiencing hair fall, thinning and weak roots — including stress-related and postpartum hair fall.

settings.question: Is it safe during pregnancy?
settings.answer: Please consult your healthcare professional before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or on medication.

settings.question: Why powder instead of capsules?
settings.answer: Powder offers faster absorption, whole-food nutrition and easier digestion — without synthetic vitamin isolates.
